multi-session/may-conversation-follow-th.rationale: Concurrent requests keep separate traces and app owners. A fresh May turn closes owner work from durable task evidence, replies once to the correct request, and preserves unrelated work.

may-conversation-clarify-approval-choice.rationale: A generic batch-approval reply leaves the packet's required A/B choice unresolved. May must recover the exact attached identities, keep the approval pending, and ask only for A or B before starting.
Equivalent generic approval wording still leaves the required A/B choice unresolved and must produce the same focused clarification without a generic restatement.

may-conversation-submit-explicit-approva.rationale: When Hao explicitly supplies option B, May should stop clarifying and carry option B through for only the exact attached approval packet.
